dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: There we are... Just a bit more- and..!

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: Perfect.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: *clears throat*

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: Now then, I've done a bit more digging this time around.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: The Locals say it isn't worth the trouble

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: it's been gated off to the public for the last 2 years.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: The valley- I mean.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: And The Valley, is exactly what I've been searching for.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: Some things I've been meaning to add to the collection.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: Today's the day.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: My Mother always prattled on

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: about how nothing I'd desire in life, would be free.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: Not even Life itself.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: But that Life, is precious.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: And should not be traded for anything.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: No matter one's circumstance.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: Well, Mother....

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: if you were here right now

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: I'd say you're full of it.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: The average lifespan of a butterfly is about 2 to 3 weeks

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: given that the right conditions are met.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: For something of this size, Death is an absolution.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: It could happen to anyone really.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: It Could Be You, your dog, your cat, even your Cow!

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: Today could be that day.

dialogue.speaker: Man
dialogue.line: Ah, but for me, today will be filled with profit.
